caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted head with exaggerated features, rendered in shades of dark brown and black for the face, and red for the lips. The head is attached to a rectangular wooden base, illustrated with brown and beige tones to show the wood grain. The wooden base has two small dowels or pegs extending downward and a central screw or bolt mechanism. The composition is centered on a plain, light-colored background without additional objects or scenery. The head is detailed with visible nostrils, defined jawline, textured lips, and slightly protruding ears. There is a signature or inscription in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Head of a Negro
